verses.1: Make a joyful noise unto Jehovah, all ye lands.
verses.2: Serve Jehovah with gladness: Come before his presence with singing.
verses.3: Know ye that Jehovah, he is God: It is he that hath made us, and we are his; We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
verses.4: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, And into his courts with praise: Give thanks unto him, and bless his name.
verses.5: For Jehovah is good; his lovingkindness endureth for ever, And his faithfulness unto all generations.

metadata.source: Derived from the American Standard Version (1901), revised for the ABIDE Bible App.
